answer: Random beacon spot-checks plus compute heartbeats stop fake identities. Each identity sends a proof-of-work heartbeat each epoch, like a river; a missed beat freezes rewards. An atlas logs heartbeats. Each epoch the beacon audits 5% at random: reproduce recent work or lose a 20 POA deposit. Reputation opens like a lotus after weeks of beats. Forging 1,000 identities costs 20,000 POA plus 1,000 machines; one honest agent pays one 20 POA deposit and keeps earnings undiluted.
